rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy – Criminal History Screening Restrictions
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers may not use a blanket policy denying housing based on arrests or convictions; applicants must be considered case-by-case. Providers may not consider arrests without conviction, convictions subject to judicial relief (expungement/sealing), juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old, unless there is a direct relationship between the conviction and the housing sought or an unreasonable risk of harm to others' safety.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies only to housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or operating income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy; not a general citywide tenant-screening law for all rentals.

rules.exemptions: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between the conviction and the housing sought, unreasonable risk of substantial harm to the safety of others, or current criminal behavior; federal or state law imposing a conflicting criminal-history requirement preempts this policy.
rules.interaction: Where federal or state law imposes a criminal-history requirement that conflicts with this guidance, the federal or state law preempts this policy (i.e., this local policy yields to federal/state law, not the reverse).

rules.conflict_note: This is a Department of Neighborhood Development administrative/funding-conditioned policy (Feb. 2017), not a codified statute or ordinance section; no section-level citation exists in the source, so the policy's title is used as the citation.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy – Credit Score/History Restrictions
rules.requirement: Covered agents may not use an applicant's credit score to approve or deny a housing application. Credit history may be considered only in lieu of rental history to assess ability to pay rent, and only when rental history is unavailable; a lack of credit history (as opposed to poor credit) is not sufficient justification to reject an applicant.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies only to housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or operating income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.

rules.exemptions: Credit history may be considered in place of rental history when rental history is not available; mitigating circumstances (e.g., a third-party payer, disability-related causes) must be accepted when insufficient credit is the basis for rejection.
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.quoted_span: The agent agrees not to use the applicant credit score to approve or deny housing
rules.conflict_note: Administrative DND policy (Feb. 2017) rather than a codified statute/ordinance; no section-level citation exists, so the policy's title is used as the citation.
